consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.text: We use storage on your device for what you ask the site to do, such as saving your interview answers. With your permission we also record where your visit came from (for example an ad or a partner site) so we know which channels bring buyers to us. No tracking runs until you choose.
consent.necessaryText: Remembers your privacy choices and the answers you give in the interview. Always on.
consent.analyticsText: Records the campaign, referring site and first page of your visit, and attaches them to your enquiry.
consent.marketingText: Records ad click identifiers (Google, Meta) so we can measure which ads bring enquiries.

italy.heading: Regions of Italy
italy.noGuide: We have no guide for this region yet, but your brief decides where we search.
italy.brief: Tell us what you want here

piemonte.name: Piedmont
piemonte.text: The Alps on three sides and wine hills in the south: the Langhe, the Roero and the Monferrato. The western shore of Lake Maggiore and Lake Orta are here too.
piemonte.airports: Turin (TRN); Milan Malpensa (MXP) for the lakes
piemonte.homes: Farmhouses among the vineyards, villas on the lakes, mountain homes

valle-d-aosta.name: Aosta Valley
valle-d-aosta.text: Italy's smallest region, high in the Alps below Mont Blanc, Monte Rosa and the Matterhorn. French is an official language alongside Italian.
valle-d-aosta.homes: Chalets and apartments in ski resorts such as Courmayeur and Cervinia, stone houses in the side valleys

lombardia.name: Lombardy
lombardia.text: Milan and the lakes: Como, Iseo, the eastern shore of Lake Maggiore and the western shore of Lake Garda, with the Alps to the north.
lombardia.homes: Villas and apartments on the lakes, apartments in Milan, chalets in the Valtellina

trentino-alto-adige.name: Trentino-South Tyrol
trentino-alto-adige.text: Two self-governing provinces in the Dolomites, Trento and Bolzano. Most people in South Tyrol speak German, and the northern tip of Lake Garda is in Trentino.
trentino-alto-adige.homes: Apartments and chalets in the mountains, homes on Lake Garda around Riva

veneto.name: Veneto
veneto.text: From the Dolomites around Cortina down to Venice and its lagoon, with the eastern shore of Lake Garda, Palladian villas and the Prosecco hills in between.
veneto.homes: Apartments in Venice and Verona, country villas, homes on the lake and in the mountains

friuli-venezia-giulia.name: Friuli Venezia Giulia
friuli-venezia-giulia.text: The north-east corner, between Austria, Slovenia and the Adriatic: Trieste, the Collio wine hills and the beaches of Grado and Lignano.
friuli-venezia-giulia.airports: Trieste (TRS); Venice (VCE) is also within reach
friuli-venezia-giulia.homes: Apartments in Trieste and Udine, country houses among the vineyards, apartments by the sea

liguria.name: Liguria
liguria.text: A narrow arc of coast between France and Tuscany, with steep terraced hills behind it: the Riviera, Portofino and the Cinque Terre.
liguria.airports: Genoa (GOA); Nice (NCE) for the western Riviera, Pisa (PSA) for the eastern end
liguria.homes: Apartments in harbour towns, houses in hill villages with a view of the sea

emilia-romagna.name: Emilia-Romagna
emilia-romagna.text: Bologna, Parma and Modena on the plain, villages in the Apennines to the south and the Adriatic beaches around Rimini.
emilia-romagna.homes: City apartments, farmhouses in the hills, apartments by the sea

toscana.name: Tuscany
toscana.text: Florence, Siena and Lucca, the hills of the Chianti and the Val d'Orcia, and a long coast from the Versilia to the Maremma, with the island of Elba.
toscana.homes: Stone farmhouses, villas, apartments in historic towns

umbria.name: Umbria
umbria.text: Green and without a coastline, between Tuscany, Lazio and the Marche: Perugia, Assisi, Orvieto and Lake Trasimeno.
umbria.airports: Perugia (PEG); Rome Fiumicino (FCO) has more connections
umbria.homes: Stone farmhouses in the countryside, houses in hill towns

marche.name: Marche
marche.text: Hills that run from the Apennines down to the Adriatic, with Urbino, Ascoli Piceno and the Conero coast near Ancona.
marche.homes: Farmhouses in the countryside, houses in hill villages, apartments by the sea

lazio.name: Lazio
lazio.text: Rome, and around it the lakes of Bolsena and Bracciano, the Tuscia hills near Viterbo and a coast that runs south to Sperlonga and Gaeta.
lazio.homes: Apartments in Rome, country houses in the Tuscia and the Sabina, homes by the sea

abruzzo.name: Abruzzo
abruzzo.text: Mountains and national parks a short drive from the Adriatic beaches, with Pescara on the coast and stone villages inland.
abruzzo.airports: Pescara (PSR); Rome Fiumicino (FCO) has more connections
abruzzo.homes: Houses in hill and mountain villages, often to renovate, and apartments on the coast

molise.name: Molise
molise.text: One of Italy's smallest regions: quiet hill villages between the Apennines and a short stretch of Adriatic coast at Termoli.
molise.airports: None in the region: Pescara (PSR), Naples (NAP) or Bari (BRI)

campania.name: Campania
campania.text: Naples and its bay, Sorrento and the Amalfi Coast, the islands of Capri and Ischia and, further south, the Cilento.
campania.homes: Apartments with a sea view, houses on the islands and in the Cilento

puglia.name: Puglia
puglia.text: The heel of Italy, with a coast on two seas, olive groves, the trulli of the Valle d'Itria and the Salento at the tip.
puglia.homes: Trulli, masserie, houses in the white towns

basilicata.name: Basilicata
basilicata.text: Between Puglia and Calabria: the Sassi of Matera, the Pollino mountains and two short coasts, Maratea on the Tyrrhenian and Metaponto on the Ionian.
basilicata.airports: None in the region: Bari (BRI) or Naples (NAP)
basilicata.homes: Houses in Matera and the hill towns, apartments by the sea at Maratea

calabria.name: Calabria
calabria.text: The toe of Italy, almost all coast and mountains: Tropea and the Costa degli Dei on the Tyrrhenian side, the Sila and the Aspromonte inland.
calabria.homes: Apartments and villas by the sea

sicilia.name: Sicily
sicilia.text: The largest island in the Mediterranean: Palermo, Catania and Etna, the baroque towns of the south-east and smaller islands such as the Aeolians.
sicilia.homes: Town houses in historic centres, villas by the sea, country houses

sardegna.name: Sardinia
sardegna.text: The second largest island in the Mediterranean, with granite coasts and clear water: the Costa Smeralda in the north-east, Alghero in the north-west, Cagliari in the south.
sardegna.homes: Villas and apartments near the beaches, stazzi (farmhouses) in the Gallura
